Wow! This Oxystone is amazing! I don't have a hard\ntime breathing at all, and my clothes don't feel\nwet. It's impressive!
If I bring it back to our world, I'll make a\nlot of money for sure...\nTee-hee-hee!
Hahaha, unfortunately we can't get enough\nOxystones to make a business out of them.
Because they're actually air-filled seaweeds that\naccumulate for a long time and turn into stones.\nIn other words, they're fossil air.
I see, so it's quite valuable. I need to treasure\nand use it carefully then...Oh my gosh?!
Hey, don't you think the fish here look weird?\nSome of them are strangely long and some are\ntoo short...
This fish species inhabits the deep sea zone below\nAqua Gota...I don't know why they are here...
In our world, deep-sea fish coming to shallow\nareas is said to be a sign that a disaster will\nhappen. I hope nothing bad will happen...
The composition of the seawater around here is\nquite different. It seems to be more similar to\nthat of the deep sea...
No wonder there are fish that seem to be from\ndeep water.
Oh my goshhhhh!\nWhat's this?!
It's probably a deep-sea creature!\nWatch out, it'll eat you alive!!
T-t-t-that's not a ghost, right...?
Oh goshhh!!
A...Profundo?!
W-w-w-what's a Profundo?
Profundo or officially Rana de Profundo are deep-\nsea dwellers in Rana's legend. They separated from\nthe Ranas and moved to live in deep waters a long
time ago. As they live in deep waters, they've\nundergone a unique transformation and haven't been\nseen by the Ranas. Why are they here now?
I-I-I-I don't think this is the right time to\nbe thinking about that!!
